name: Dialga-EX + Aegislash-EX Hyper Metal Chain Deck

releases.name: Dialga-EX + Aegislash-EX Hyper Metal Chain Deck

description.text: Hyper Metal Chain Deck 60: Dialga-EX + Aegislash-EX, a ready-built 60-card Metal deck released on 13 September 2014. Its chain is Bronzong's Ability Metal Links, which attaches a Metal Energy card from the discard pile to a Benched Pokémon once a turn, feeding Dialga-EX and Aegislash-EX, a pairing that let newcomers keep up with strong players. Unlike most ready-built decks it came with only a player's guide, without a coin or damage counters. Now and then a deck held a secret card.
